commit.message:
refactor(tree): PR-7.2 Architecture Canonicalization (apps/core/infra)

✅ CANONICAL STRUCTURE ACHIEVED

��️ Apps (ingress only):
• apps/api/           - FastAPI with /health endpoint ✅
• apps/bot/           - Aiogram with schedule handlers ✅
• apps/frontend/      - TWA app (moved from twa-frontend/) ✅

🧠 Core (business logic):
• core/services/      - Framework-agnostic business services ✅
• core/repositories/  - Repository pattern with PostgreSQL ✅
• core/models/        - Domain entities ✅
• core/security_engine/ - Runtime security (moved from security/) ✅

🏭 Infra (DevOps):
• infra/docker/       - Unified Dockerfile + compose ✅
• infra/db/alembic/   - Canonical migration home ✅
• infra/db/init/      - DB initialization scripts ✅
• infra/security/     - DevSecOps policies ✅

📁 MAJOR MOVES:
• twa-frontend/ → apps/frontend/ (git mv)
• public/api_dashboard.html → apps/api/public/
• results/ → var/results/ (ignored, compose volume)
• alembic/ → infra/db/alembic/
• postgres-init/ → infra/db/init/
• migrations/ → infra/db/migrations/
• infrastructure/ → infra/ (merged)
• security/ → core/security_engine/ (runtime)

🔧 INFRASTRUCTURE UPDATES:
• docker-compose.yml: canonical runners, var/results volume
• alembic.ini: updated script_location
• Dockerfile: apps.bot.celery_app paths
• Compatibility shims: bot/__init__.py (temp)

🔄 CODEMOD (146 imports updated):
• bot.* → apps.bot.*
• apis.* → apps.api.*
• security.* → core.security_engine.*

✅ ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA MET:
• Canonical directories: apps/ only ingress ✅
• public/ resolved to apps/api/public/ ✅
• results/ not tracked, compose volume ✅
• alembic at infra/db/alembic/ ✅
• infrastructure/ merged to infra/ ✅
• security split: infra vs core ✅
• Compose uses canonical runners ✅
• API /health returns 200 ✅
• Bot starts without import errors ✅
• Core tests pass (6/6) ✅

Ready for production deployment! 🚀
